description: Each payment is credited to the staff member recorded on the payment itself as having processed it.

a.request: Considering only payments that link to a rental record, credit each payment to the staff member who processed the payment (`payment.staff_id`). For each such staff member, return the staff ID, the total payment `amount`, and that total as a fraction of the combined total across all staff members. Do not round anything.
a.sql: WITH staff_totals AS (SELECT p.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount FROM payment AS p JOIN rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY p.staff_id) SELECT staff_id, total_amount, total_amount / SUM(total_amount) OVER () AS fraction_of_total FROM staff_totals ORDER BY staff_id

b.request: For payments with a non-null rental_id, group by payment.staff_id and show each staff ID, the sum of its payment.amount values, and that sum divided by the sum of payment.amount across all such payments, without rounding
b.sql: SELECT staff_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, SUM(amount) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payment WHERE rental_id IS NOT NULL) AS share_of_total FROM payment WHERE rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY staff_id ORDER BY staff_id

c.request: For payments that link to a rental, how much payment revenue does each staff member bring in? Show the staff ID, their total payment `amount`, and that total as a fraction of the combined total across all staff. No rounding. Each payment is credited to the staff member recorded on the payment itself as having processed it.
c.sql: SELECT p.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount, SUM(p.amount) / (SELECT SUM(p2.amount) FROM payment AS p2 WHERE p2.rental_id IS NOT NULL) AS fraction_of_total FROM payment AS p WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.staff_id ORDER BY p.staff_id;

d.request: For payments linked to a rental, how much revenue did each staff member process, based on the staff member recorded on each payment? Show the staff ID, the sum of their payment `amount`, and that sum as a fraction of the combined total across all staff, without rounding.
d.sql: SELECT staff_id, SUM(amount) AS revenue, SUM(amount) * 1.0 / SUM(SUM(amount)) OVER () AS revenue_fraction FROM payment WHERE rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY staff_id ORDER BY staff_id
